items.title: Targa Resources (TRGP) Stock May Be 48% Undervalued Despite Permian Power Deal
items.summary: Targa Resources has had a powerful multi‑year run, and with the stock now around US$283, the key issue for investors is whether that price still lines up with the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 5 years the share price has risen by a very large amount, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash flows can justify that journey. New long term power contracts supporting Targa Resources' Permian Basin gas processing expansion may influence future cash flow...

items.title: Targa Resources (TRGP) Secures 230 Megawatts Of Long Term Power Capacity
items.summary: Targa Resources (NYSE:TRGP) agreed long term power supply deals with PROPWR covering 230 megawatts for Permian Basin projects. The multi year contracts are structured to support Targa Resources' expanding natural gas processing infrastructure in the region. PROPWR's commitment secures a large block of capacity that can be allocated to Targa Resources' future energy requirements. The new 230 megawatt power agreement with PROPWR is only one piece of what matters for Targa Resources today...

items.title: ProPetro's PROPWR Expands Power Footprint With Targa Deal
items.summary: PUMP's PROPWR secures 230 MW in long-term TRGP contracts, lifting committed capacity to 510 MW and widening its Permian on-site power footprint.
